The pilot reported that the weather was poor and he estimated his arrival in Winnipeg at 8:00 p.m. At 5:50 p.m. there was radio contact with the pilot where he stated that he was over Poplar River. This was the last radio contact with this helicopter. The Canadian Air Search and Rescue, private aircraft and police aircraft searched until November 17, 1972 when the search was suspended until the spring of 1973. Nathan Kryger and Ian Fraser are presumed dead as a result of the helicopter crash. Foul play is not suspected.

Case reference: 2014001925.CaseDesc: On July 3, 1976, Maggie Natomagan was last seen in Pinehouse, Saskatchewan. Maggie was known to walk in the bush near the community, however, searches failed to locate any trace of her.

Case reference: 2014002505.CaseDesc: On January 27, 1988, Lisa Somerton was seen for the last time outside of her residence located at 1220 Merivale Road in Ottawa, Ontario. She was observed approaching a black sports car with two people inside.

Case reference: 2009000199.CaseDesc: On October 17, 1996, Alf Joergensen left his residence to go on a business trip to London, England. Alf told his wife he would be returning on either October 22nd or 23rd 1996. He indicated he was meeting a business associate in London, however it was later confirmed there were no scheduled business meetings with this particular individual, who hadn't seen Alf since the previous year. Alf flew to England on October 17, 1996 and was confirmed to have flown into Toronto airport on October 19, 1996, via British Airways. Alf has not been seen nor heard from since this date and his family and police are concerned for his safety and well-being.

Case reference: 2006010999.CaseDesc: It is believed that Sander Lingman became lost while staking claims near Gripp Lake, 69 kilometres north west of Nakina, Ontario. They were unable to find Sander, despite intensive searches of the area.

Case reference: 2014005307.CaseDesc: On August 14, 2006, Kevin Lim, Yee Wah Eva Ho and her boyfriend Jackie Li were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Kevin, Yee Wah Eva and Jackie had been friends with Philip Sit who had been reported missing in 2005. Philip’s remains were found five days prior to Eva, Kevin and Jackie’s disappearance. Philip had been the victim of a homicide.

Hair: Black, Straight, Dyed, Dyed red and styled with spikes

Case reference: 2014002868.CaseDesc: On August 2, 1989, Ronald Jack last spoke with his mother. During that telephone discussion, Ronald had informed her that he and his wife, Doreen Jack, would be leaving for a “camp job”. He had also said that they would be gone for approximately 10 days, and would be back before their sons, Russell and Ryan Jack, started their school year in September.

Case reference: 2006013999.CaseDesc: Walter Glynn was last seen on July 23, 1980 walking southbound on Main Street, Kirkland Lake.  He was heading to the A&P grocery store at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2013000125.CaseDesc: Bonnie Joan Thomas (born Cooper) of Rollingdam, outside of St. Stephen, New Brunswick, met some friends and went across the U.S.A. border to the Legion in Calais, Maine. They went to a St. Patrick's Day dance and after the evening's celebrations, Bonnie left the Legion alone in her 1973 red Volvo station wagon. Bonnie drove back through the Calais/St. Stephen border crossing into Canada. At the Canadian entry point, Bonnie hit the customs booth causing minor damage to her car and was last seen talking to the Customs Officer. The following morning Bonnie's husband realized she was missing, and called the police. On March 18, 1978, Bonnie's car was found abandoned near St. Stephen on a logging road near the St Croix River.
